text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho—hark, what great majesty rings from those words! A victory today would surely boost my overlordly influence.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I am to become the king of all kings. Thus, I shall leave my legacy on that legendary stage!
